all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ غُرَابࣰ ا يَبۡحَثُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيُرِيَهُۥ كَيۡفَ يُوَٰرِي سَوۡءَةَ أَخِيهِۚ قَالَ يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰٓ أَعَجَزۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِثۡلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡغُرَابِ فَأُوَٰرِيَ سَوۡءَةَ أَخِيۖ فَأَصۡبَحَ مِنَ ٱلنَّٰدِمِينَ

translations.saheeh: Then Allah sent a crow searching in the ground to show him how to hide the disgrace of his brother. He said, "O woe to me! Have I failed to be like this crow and hide the body of my brother?" And he became of the regretful.
translations.pickthall: Then Allah sent a raven scratching up the ground, to show him how to hide his brother's naked corpse. He said: Woe unto me! Am I not able to be as this raven and so hide my brother's naked corpse? And he became repentant.
translations.khattab: Then Allah sent a crow digging ˹a grave˺ in the ground ˹for a dead crow˺, in order to show him how to bury the corpse of his brother. He cried, “Alas! Have I ˹even˺ failed to be like this crow and bury the corpse of my brother?” So he became regretful
translations.arberry: Then God sent forth a raven, scratching into the earth, to show him how he might conceal the vile body of his brother. He said, 'Woe is me! Am I unable to be as this raven, and so conceal my brother's vile body?' And he became one of the remorseful.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ مَا تُوعَدُونَ لَأٓتࣲۖ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not cause failure [to Allah].
translations.pickthall: Lo! that which ye are promised will surely come to pass, and ye cannot escape.
translations.khattab: Indeed, what you have been promised will certainly come to pass. And you will have no escape
translations.arberry: The thing you are promised, that will surely come; you cannot frustrate it.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَا يَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ سَبَقُوٓاْۚ إِنَّهُمۡ لَا يُعۡجِزُونَ

translations.saheeh: And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure [to Allah].
translations.pickthall: And let not those who disbelieve suppose that they can outstrip (Allah's Purpose). Lo! they cannot escape.
translations.khattab: Do not let those disbelievers think they are not within reach. They will have no escape
translations.arberry: And thou art not to suppose that they who disbelieve have outstripped Me; they cannot frustrate My will.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَسِيحُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَرۡبَعَةَ أَشۡهُرࣲ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّكُمۡ غَيۡرُ مُعۡجِزِي ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡزِي ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

translations.saheeh: So travel freely, [O disbelievers], throughout the land [during] four months but know that you cannot cause failure to Allah and that Allah will disgrace the disbelievers.
translations.pickthall: Travel freely in the land four months, and know that ye cannot escape Allah and that Allah will confound the disbelievers (in His Guidance).
translations.khattab: “You ˹polytheists˺ may travel freely through the land for four months, but know that you will have no escape from Allah, and that Allah will disgrace the disbelievers.”
translations.arberry: 'Journey freely in the land for four months; and know that you cannot frustrate the will of God, and that God degrades the unbelievers.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَذَٰنࣱ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحَجِّ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَرِيٓءࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُۥۚ فَإِن تُبۡتُمۡ فَهُوَ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكُمۡۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّكُمۡ غَيۡرُ مُعۡجِزِي ٱللَّهِۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

translations.saheeh: And [it is] an announcement from Allah and His Messenger to the people on the day of the greater pilgrimage that Allah is disassociated from the disbelievers, and [so is] His Messenger. So if you repent, that is best for you; but if you turn away - then know that you will not cause failure to Allah. And give tidings to those who disbelieve of a painful punishment.
translations.pickthall: And a proclamation from Allah and His messenger to all men on the day of the Greater Pilgrimage that Allah is free from obligation to the idolaters, and (so is) His messenger. So, if ye repent, it will be better for you; but if ye are averse, then know that ye cannot escape Allah. Give tidings (O Muhammad) of a painful doom to those who disbelieve,
translations.khattab: A declaration from Allah and His Messenger ˹is made˺ to all people on the day of the greater pilgrimage that Allah and His Messenger are free of the polytheists. So if you ˹pagans˺ repent, it will be better for you. But if you turn away, then know that you will have no escape from Allah. And give good news ˹O Prophet˺ to the disbelievers of a painful punishment
translations.arberry: A proclamation, from God and His Messenger, unto mankind on the day of the Greater Pilgrimage: 'God is quit, and His Messenger, of the idolaters. So if you repent, that will be better for you; but if you turn your backs; know that you cannot frustrate the will of God. And give thou good tidings to the unbelievers of a painful chastisement;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ۞وَيَسۡتَنۢبِـُٔونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَۖ قُلۡ إِي وَرَبِّيٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقࣱّۖ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ

translations.saheeh: And they ask information of you, [O Muhammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allah]."
translations.pickthall: And they ask thee to inform them (saying): Is it true? Say: Yea, by my Lord, verily it is true, and ye cannot escape.
translations.khattab: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺, “Is this true?” Say, “Yes, by my Lord! Most certainly it is true! And you will have no escape.”
translations.arberry: They ask thee to tell them, 'Is it true?' Say: 'Yes, by my Lord! It is true; you cannot frustrate Him.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَمۡ يَكُونُواْ مُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَۘ يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ مَا كَانُواْ يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَمَا كَانُواْ يُبۡصِرُونَ

translations.saheeh: Those were not causing failure [to Allah] on earth, nor did they have besides Allah any protectors. For them the punishment will be multiplied. They were not able to hear, nor did they see.
translations.pickthall: Such will not escape in the earth, nor have they any protecting friends beside Allah. For them the torment will be double. They could not bear to hear, and they used not to see.
translations.khattab: They will never frustrate Allah on earth, and they will have no protector besides Allah. Their punishment will be multiplied, for they failed to hear or see ˹the truth˺
translations.arberry: they are unable to frustrate Him on earth and they have no protectors, apart from God. For them the chastisement shall be doubled; they could not hear, neither did they see.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأۡتِيكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ إِن شَآءَ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ

translations.saheeh: He said, "Allah will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure.
translations.pickthall: He said: Only Allah will bring it upon you if He will, and ye can by no means escape.
translations.khattab: He responded, “It is Allah Who can bring it upon you if He wills, and then you will have no escape
translations.arberry: He said, 'God will bring you it if He will; you cannot frustrate Him.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالَتۡ يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزࣱ وَهَٰذَا بَعۡلِي شَيۡخًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عَجِيبࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"
translations.pickthall: She said: Oh woe is me! Shall I bear a child when I am an old woman, and this my husband is an old man? Lo! this is a strange thing!
translations.khattab: She wondered, “Oh, my! How can I have a child in this old age, and my husband here is an old man? This is truly an astonishing thing!”
translations.arberry: She said, 'Woe is me! Shall I bear, being an old woman, and this my husband is an old man? This assuredly is a strange thing.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوۡ يَأۡخُذَهُمۡ فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمۡ فَمَا هُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ

translations.saheeh: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure?
translations.pickthall: Or that He will not seize them in their going to and fro so that there be no escape for them?
translations.khattab: Or that He will not seize them while they go about ˹their day˺, for then they will have no escape
translations.arberry: Or that He will not seize them in their going to and fro, and they will not be able to frustrate Him?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوۡاْ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: While those who strive to thwart Our revelations, such are rightful owners of the Fire.
translations.khattab: But those who strive to discredit Our revelations, they will be the residents of the Hellfire.”
translations.arberry: And those who strive against Our signs to void them -- they shall be the inhabitants of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ وَلَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

translations.saheeh: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allah] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.
translations.pickthall: Think not that the disbelievers can escape in the land. Fire will be their home - a hapless journey's end!
translations.khattab: Do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that the disbelievers can escape in the land. The Fire will be their home. Indeed, what an evil destination
translations.arberry: Think not the unbelievers able to frustrate God in the earth; their refuge is the Fire -- an evil homecoming.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

translations.saheeh: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
translations.pickthall: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.
translations.khattab: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed
translations.arberry: save an old woman among those that tarried;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيࣲّ وَلَا نَصِيرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allah any protector or any helper.
translations.pickthall: Ye cannot escape (from Him) in the earth or in the sky, and beside Allah there is for you no friend or helper.
translations.khattab: And you cannot escape Him on earth or in heaven. Nor have you any protector or helper besides Allah.”
translations.arberry: You are not able to frustrate Him either in the earth or in heaven; and you have not, apart from God, either protector or helper.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوۡ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.
translations.pickthall: But those who strive against Our revelations, challenging (Us), theirs will be a painful doom of wrath.
translations.khattab: As for those who strive to discredit Our revelations, it is they who will suffer the ˹worst˺ torment of agonizing pain
translations.arberry: 'And those who strive against Our signs to void them -- theirs shall be a chastisement of painful wrath.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡعَوۡنَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُحۡضَرُونَ

translations.saheeh: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
translations.pickthall: And as for those who strive against Our revelations, challenging, they will be brought to the doom.
translations.khattab: As for those who strive to discredit Our revelations, it is they who will be confined in punishment
translations.arberry: And those who strive against Our signs to void them -- those shall be arraigned into the chastisement.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةࣰۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعۡجِزَهُۥ مِن شَيۡءࣲ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمࣰ ا قَدِيرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.
translations.pickthall: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them, and they were mightier than these in power? Allah is not such that aught in the heavens or in the earth escapeth Him. Lo! He is the Wise, the Mighty.
translations.khattab: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those ˹destroyed˺ before them? They were far superior in might. But there is nothing that can escape Allah in the heavens or the earth. He is certainly All-Knowing, Most Capable
translations.arberry: What, have they not journeyed in the land and beheld how was the end of those before them? They were stronger than themselves in might; but God -- there is naught in the heavens or the earth that can frustrate Him. Surely He is All-knowing, All-powerful.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

translations.saheeh: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
translations.pickthall: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;
translations.khattab: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed
translations.arberry: save an old woman among those that tarried;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَمَا هُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ

translations.saheeh: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be afflicted by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.
translations.pickthall: But the evils that they earned smote them; and such of these as do wrong, the evils that they earn will smite them; they cannot escape.
translations.khattab: So the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds overtook them. And the wrongdoers among these ˹pagans˺ will be overtaken by the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds. And they will have no escape
translations.arberry: in that the evils of that they earned smote them. The evildoers of these men, they too shall be smitten by the evils -- of that they earned; they will not be able to frustrate it.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيࣲّ وَلَا نَصِيرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper.
translations.pickthall: Ye cannot escape in the earth, for beside Allah ye have no protecting friend nor any helper.
translations.khattab: You can never escape ˹Him˺ on earth, nor do you have any protector or helper besides Allah
translations.arberry: You are not able to frustrate Him in the earth; and, apart from God, you have neither protector nor helper.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبۡ دَاعِيَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيۡسَ بِمُعۡجِزࣲ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَيۡسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءُۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ

translations.saheeh: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allah will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."
translations.pickthall: And whoso respondeth not to Allah's summoner he can nowise escape in the earth, and he hath no protecting friends instead of Him. Such are in error manifest.
translations.khattab: And whoever does not respond to the caller of Allah will have no escape on earth, nor will they have any protectors against Him. It is they who are clearly astray.”
translations.arberry: Whosoever answers not God's summoner cannot frustrate God in the earth, and he has no protectors apart from Him; those are in manifest error.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةࣲ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
translations.pickthall: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
translations.khattab: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”
translations.arberry: Then came forward his wife, clamouring, and she smote her face, and said, 'An old woman, barren!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلࣲ مُّنقَعِرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
translations.pickthall: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.
translations.khattab: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees
translations.arberry: plucking up men as if they were stumps of uprooted palm-trees.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
translations.pickthall: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
translations.khattab: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees
translations.arberry: violent that He compelled against them seven nights and eight days, uninterruptedly, and thou mightest see the people laid prostrate in it as if they were the stumps of fallen down palm-trees.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
translations.pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
translations.khattab: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺
translations.arberry: Indeed, we thought that we should never be able to frustrate God in the earth, neither be able to frustrate Him by flight.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
translations.pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
translations.khattab: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺
translations.arberry: Indeed, we thought that we should never be able to frustrate God in the earth, neither be able to frustrate Him by flight.
